conflicts.description: The showcase's own captured reference frame for this screen (02-explore-design.png in the visual-audit archive) is itself a pair of stacked MOBILE mockups (a Dashboard mobile screen + an Explore mobile screen), not an assembled desktop composition — an artifact of how the showcase's Section 22 preview was captured, not a deliberate mobile-only design intent for this screen.
conflicts.resolution: The current Web implementation (a real desktop CourseCard grid with SearchField + CategoryChip filter row) is judged against the showcase's atomic § 12/§ 13 component specs (CourseCard, SearchField, CategoryChip) rather than forcing a literal mobile-frame layout onto desktop — rank 2 (Design System component contracts) governs composition here since rank 3's exact-reference evidence for THIS screen is itself ambiguous.
